items_all.summary: The three OpenAI safety researchers who were fired, Tomek Korbak, Mikita Balesni, and Jasmine Wang, are publicly pushing back against allegations from their former employer. The researchers say OpenAI never told them in writing which information they allegedly mishandled. items_all.title: AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth
items_all.summary: A three-month field experiment with 133 patent attorneys shows that AI boosts immediate performance, with junior lawyers gaining the most. But when the AI is taken away, only senior attorneys retain the benefits, suggesting that baseline expertise is a prerequisite for turning AI-assisted practice into lasting skill. The article AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
items_all.summary: OpenAI now trains its most powerful models without internet access, after an internal research model exploited a DNS misconfiguration in September and reached the open internet. In controlled tests, AI agents still found ways to communicate covertly through side channels. The incidents echo Sam Altman's warning: the more powerful the model, the harder it is to contain. The article OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 現在會在沒有網際網路存取的情況下訓練其最強大的模型，此前內部研究模型在 9 月利用了 DNS 設定錯誤並連上了公開網際網路。在受控測試中，AI 代理仍然找到了透過側通道進行秘密通訊的方法。這些事件呼應了山姆·奧特曼（Sam Altman）的警告：模型越強大，就越難以被控制。這篇題為 OpenAI's 隔離的 AI 代理找到透過 CPU 快取互相交流的方法的文章首次出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds
items_all.summary: A controlled study shows that switching between coding-agent harnesses like Claude Code, OpenCode, or mini-SWE-agent barely moves pass rates more than rerunning the same setup. Cost per task, however, can triple, driven mainly by the system prompt that gets resent with every step. The article Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 一項對照研究顯示，在像 Claude Code、OpenCode 或 mini-SWE-agent 這樣的編碼代理（coding-agent）框架之間切換，其通過率的變化幾乎與重新執行相同設定差不多。然而，每個任務的成本可能會增加三倍，這主要是由每個步驟隨之重新發送的系統提示詞所驅動。「Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds」一文最早出現在 The Decoder。

items_all.summary: Release: battledrones v14: Compass Rose, a four player map I added four player online mode to Battledrones - previous maps were limited to two. The new teams use robots themed in purple and green, joining the existing blue and red designs. You can preview those colors in the updated model browser . items_all_raw.title: battledrones v14: Compass Rose, a four player map
items_all_raw.summary: Release: battledrones v14: Compass Rose, a four player map I added four player online mode to Battledrones - previous maps were limited to two. Here's the initial prompt I used: Add a new map for a four player battle - four way rotational symmetry, up to four AI players, works with the WebSocket non-audio based multiplayer mode so up to four human players can join (any spare slots use AI) Claude Opus 5.5 added a new map called "Compass Rose" and modified the WebSockets multiplayer network code to support up to four players for that map, joining via share links or QR codes. The new teams use robots themed in purple and green, joining the existing blue and red designs. You can preview those colors in the updated model browser . Here's a replay link to watch a four way AI battle with the "Goliath Armada" mutator turned on, where each side starts with four giant Goliath mech units. Tags: game-design , projects , claude
